title: Snapshot S2194 starts with page chrome (Repository navigation, You must be signed in) although its header says page chrome removed
goal: fetch._PageText, the reducer provider.doc_text uses to write a snapshot, leaves out the visually hidden heading and the role=tooltip text of a GitHub repository page (Repository navigation, You must be signed in to star a repository) and keeps the page's body; kb/public/_snapshots/S2194.txt, rewritten with it, starts with the page body as its header line says. Found by the SP-5bvg4tnl review (BG-gjqcfpw4, pre-existing).

run:
import sys
bad = []
for s in ("S2189", "S2194"):
    body = open("kb/public/_snapshots/%s.txt" % s, encoding="utf-8").read()
    if "Repository navigation" in body or "You must be signed in" in body:
        bad.append(s)
print(bad); sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)

repro_reason: The snapshot is written from the live page over the network; the stored file is what review reads, so the repro reads it.
